video.subject_count.evidence: [director·claude] 人数对不上，部分格也看不清。0.000 格除左、右两个树人外，中景马头前方还有两个较小的树影，像是 4 个，与规格的 3 个不符，但缩略图太小，拿不准。0.750 格右侧前景突然出现一个贴近镜头、大到半格高的树人，1.000 格同样如此，看不出它是三个中的哪一个。2.000–9.750 各格能数到左 1、右 2 共 3 个。10.000 格画面里只能明确看到左、右两个裹着蓝光的树人，第三个不在画内。12.000–13.750 各格只能在左下角、右下角认出两堆倒伏枯树，第三具遗骸无法确认。开头与结尾数量对不上，判不过。

video.timeline.evidence: [director·claude] 有多处缺拍、错时和画面跳变。① 1–1.6 s 斜劈：1.250–1.750 格有出剑，1.750 格被砍树人胸口出现橙红色亮斑。木屑不明显，而且橙色光违反规格中「除马眼窝绿光外不许有其他颜色光」的要求。② 1.6–2.1 s 举剑指天、剑身胸口亮冷蓝光：2.000–3.750 格都没有出现，他持剑平端，没有冷蓝光。③ 2.1–2.7 s 护盾成形：实际在 4.500 格胸口才亮蓝光，4.750 格薄膜球才出现，比规格晚约 2.4 s。④ 3.750→4.000 格之间整个构图突变，人马变小、位置左移，三个树人重新站位，属于跳切或换机位，违反「一镜到底」。9.750→10.000 格之间人马变大、居中，也是一次跳变。⑤ 2.7–10.4 s 盾内挥剑：实际只有 4.75–10 s；可见的砍中闪光只在 7.000、8.250、9.250 格，间隔约 1.25 s，比规格的约 0.8 s 慢。闪光都落在左侧树人身上，没有左、右、前轮流。6.250 和 9.500 格他把剑高举，有举剑停顿的样子。⑥ 盾灭与贴身星爆：约在 10.000 格（规格 10.4 s），但只看到两团蓝光。⑦ 10.250–11.000 格有倒飞、倒地，基本符合规格的 10.7–12 s。⑧ 12–14 s 收势：剑垂马侧、13.250 格马喷白气、末尾静止，这一段发生了。

video.scale.evidence: [director·claude] 规格要求树人（1.9 m）站在马旁只到马上骑手的腰。实际：4.000 格左侧树人从画面顶部附近一直站到底部，明显高过马上骑手的头顶；6.000、7.750、8.000 格右侧树人的树冠与骑手头部齐平或更高，左侧树人前倾时也和骑手肩部一样高。0.750 和 1.000 格前景树人比整组人马还大。这些树人都远超「到骑手腰」的比例，像巨型树怪。

video.head_tail.evidence: [director·claude] 开头：0.000–1.000 格只有骑手站定和树人冲锋，没有特效，是清楚的开场。结尾：11.250 格起三个树人（只能确认两堆）已成倒伏枯树，护盾和星爆散尽，只剩薄雾。12.000–13.750 格他剑垂马侧、坐姿稳定，13.250 格马喷一口白气，与规格这一拍一致。13.500 与 13.750 两格人物和机位基本相同，没有新动作。

video.agency.evidence: [地狱领主·claude] Image 1 (the 4fps contact sheet). 0–1s: from 0.0 to 1.0s I sit still while the treants charge, which is fine as wind-up. Around 1.25–1.75s my right arm moves and the treant on the right shows an orange-red wound mark, so the first strike seems to land. The problems start after that. 2.0–3.75s (all of row 2): the treants are close around me, yet I just hold the sword level. I don't raise it and no shield forms. Per the spec I should point the sword at the sky at 1.6s and the shield should form by 2.1–2.7s, so this is about 2 seconds of waiting. 4.0–4.5s: I raise the sword skyward and only at 4.75s does the sphere form, which is clearly late. 4.5–6.25s: across about 7 frames, the 4.5s frame and every frame from 5.0s on show the sword raised straight up, held near the sky. I'm not cutting continuously, which hits the negative prompts "举剑指天定住" (sword frozen pointing at the sky) and "护盾成形后停顿" (pause after the shield forms). 6.5–9.75s: clear hits with a cold-blue flash only show at 7.0, 8.25 and 9.25s, every 1.0–1.25s. All three go at the left treant, and 8.0s also points left. I never strike right or front, which misses the spec's 0.8s rhythm and left/right/front rotation. The treants also stand some distance off the membrane in many frames (e.g. 5.0–5.75, 6.75), so most cuts look like 对空挥剑 (swinging at empty air). Overall: I wait in place, freeze with the sword raised, and strike too slowly in one direction only.；[树人·claude] 图1 第1–2行（0–1.75s）：我们三个树人从左、右、前方冲向骑手，约1.25–1.75s冲到他身边，这一段合理。2.0–3.75s：我们围着骑手站，只在2.75s看到左侧树人抡臂，其余格里扑打不连续，被砍后也看不出明显的退缩再扑上来。第3行4.0–4.5s：骑手举剑蓄力，正是最该趁机猛砸的时候，我们却退到画面左右两边，离他很远，站着不动，没有砸向他。规格要求1.6–2.1s三个树人同时砸下，这里落空，原地空等，离得也太远。第3–5行4.75–9.75s护盾阶段：我们大多保持把枝杈臂伸向盾面的姿势，几乎不变（例如6.0、7.5、8.75s），看不出约0.7秒一下的抽打和被弹开的节奏，更像在轻碰或推着护盾。被骑手砍中时（7.0、8.25、9.25s出现寒光），4fps下也看不清一缩、踉跄后再扑上来的动作。第6行10.0–11.0s被炸得倒飞、倒地，这一段对。拿不准的地方：护盾阶段在4fps下有没有快速抽打，单看拼图无法确认。

video.gaze.evidence: [地狱领主·claude] Image 1 (the 4fps contact sheet). My head is very small in each cell, so I can't reliably read where my eyes point. The orientation I can make out has these problems. 0–1.0s: my head faces the camera or front-left rather than clearly locking onto the treants charging from the right and front. 2.0–3.75s: the treant on the right is wounded and pressing in, but I keep a frontal pose; I can't confirm I'm watching it. 5.0–6.25s, sword raised inside the shield: my face is nearly frontal to the camera, not toward the treants on either side. 7.0, 8.25 and 9.25s: I strike left, but I can't tell whether my head turns to follow the target. 10.0–11.0s: I can't confirm my gaze sweeps across all three treants. 12.0–13.75s: my head faces the camera and doesn't clearly see off the three fallen trunks on either side. Because I can't confirm sustained watching of the enemies, and several frames suggest I'm facing the camera, this is a fail.；[树人·claude] 图1 0–1.75s：我们冲锋时躯干和树冠都朝向画面中央的骑手。2.0–3.75s：围在他身边的树人身体和手臂都指向他。4.0–4.5s：左右两个树人虽然站得远，身体仍然转向中间的他。4.75–9.75s：左、右侧树人始终面朝护盾中心，枝杈臂伸向骑手，没有看镜头或发呆的格子。10.0s以后是被炸飞、倒地的格子，按规则不计。保留意见：我们没有嘴，五官不清楚，只能凭树冠和躯干的朝向判断视线；1.0s前景那个树人运动模糊较重，头的朝向看不太清。

video.readability.evidence: [audience·claude] 第1张拼图。4.75–9.75秒这段能看懂：骑士举剑，身边张开一个蓝色球形护盾，两侧树人朝护盾挥爪，7.0、8.25、9.25秒有蓝色撞击火花；10.0–11.0秒两只树人身上出现蓝光并炸成碎片，11.0–13.75秒只剩骑士站在雾里。但有三处说不清：①0–3.75秒混战很乱，中间一只树人胸口发橙光（1.75–3.75秒），看不出是谁的什么技能造成的，也看不出结果。②4.0秒画面突然跳切，那只发橙光的树人不见了，各单位位置也全变了，前后两段接不上。③10.0秒护盾消失的同一帧，蓝光直接出现在两只树人的手和身上，看不到能量从骑士或护盾飞出去的过程，第一次看的观众分不清是骑士的技能炸了它们，还是树人自己爆了。一眼看懂的标准没达到，判 fail。

video.fidelity.evidence: [fidelity·claude] Fail on two clear problems, plus some points I can't confirm at this frame size. Clear problem 1, wrong hit colour: the opening sword hit should burst cold blue with frost and wood chips. Instead, sheet 1 at 1.75 s (row 1, frame 8) and 2.0–3.75 s (all of row 2) shows a lasting orange-red glow, like embers, on the struck treant's chest and shoulder. That means a non-blue light, and it doesn't flash and go out. Clear problem 2, the shield break burst: at 10.0 s (row 6, frame 1) the bursts on the left and right treants are large white-blue glare blobs with flare streaks, much bigger than a treant's upper body. The locked look is a body-hugging cold-blue light about upper-body size that flashes and scatters, with no big light-flower. Also, only two bursts are visible in that frame; I can't see the third treant's. What matches: from 4.75 to 9.75 s (end of row 3 through row 5) the inner layer is a translucent pale-blue thin-film sphere that wraps horse and rider, not a solid ball. Uncertain: (a) the outer rings. In the frames I can mostly make out one roughly horizontal ring and a few tilted arcs, and I can't confirm 3–4 thin rings in clearly different horizontal, vertical and tilted planes that keep rotating, as in the locked shield look and the original reference's 'gyroscope of faint rings' (sheet 2, row 3). (b) Hits inside the shield. Blue flashes appear only at 7.0, 8.25 and 9.25 s, roughly once every 1.1–1.25 s, and all on the left treant. The right treant reaches in from outside the film throughout 6.0–9.75 s, and I see no clear frame of the blade passing through the film into it, so the locked pattern of 'a cut every 0.8 s, rotating left, right and front, a small blue frost burst at each hit' doesn't come through. On the reference itself: sheet 2's original DotA 1 frames show the original break as a yellow-green spiky starburst (4:01.0–4:01.9). The spec deliberately changes this to cold blue, so the reference can't excuse the oversized glare at 10.0 s.

video.attack_contact.evidence: [director·claude] ① 盾内只有 7.000、8.250、9.250 格能看到剑刃与左侧树人手臂、胸口重叠并迸出蓝白光；右侧两个树人在 4.750–9.750 格从没被砍中，也没有受击后一缩的反应。② 5.000–5.750、6.500–6.750、8.500–8.750、9.500–9.750 等格，他的剑停在盾内或高举，没有穿出薄膜碰到树人，属于对空挥或举剑停住。③ 右侧树人在 6.000–9.750 格虽然伸臂朝向盾，但多数格里臂端与薄膜之间看得出空隙，没有看到弹开的涟漪，「贴盾抽打」接触不成立。④ 规格 1–1.6 s 的首劈：1.500–1.750 格剑与中间树人重叠、出现亮斑，算接触，但亮斑是橙色，不符合规格。整体多数攻击没有实际打到目标，判不过。

video.stun_visible.evidence: [audience·claude] 第1张拼图从头到尾，任何单位头顶都没有旋涡或眩晕标记。4.75–9.75秒两只树人一直在动，反复向护盾挥爪（6.0–9.75秒各格姿势都不一样），没有一个停在原地不动。10.0秒它们被蓝光击中，10.25–11.0秒直接碎掉，中间没有一段被晕住的停顿。观众说不出哪个单位被晕了、晕了多久，只能看到受击和被炸碎。
